basic_info.description: Located in the heart of vibrant Hayes Valley, 241 Lily Street #B offers timeless San Francisco living in a 2 unit, well-maintained Edwardian building from 1909, converted to condos in 2013. This top-floor unit blends classic charm with modern upgrades. A spacious entry hall sets the tone for the home's thoughtful layout. Upstairs, the north-facing living room is filled with natural light. Off the hallway are a laundry closet and the larger of two bedrooms. At the center of the home is a spa-like bath with soaking tub, dual showers, and a Caesarstone vanity. The second bedroom enjoys abundant sunlight from its corner windows. The dining room connects to the living room through double doors, and a separate access door opens to a private porch that leads to a shared outdoor area with an HOA BBQ. The stylish kitchen, updated in 2014, features LG stainless steel appliances, Caesarstone counters, under-cabinet lighting, a prep sink, a farmhouse-style sink with on-demand hot water, and a sunny window. Recessed lighting, hardwood floors, and a 200+ sq ft. deeded basement storage complete this charming home. Don't miss this special opportunity.
